eligibility.michigan_requires: Michigan requires a few quick eligibility questions before you can register online.
eligibility.citizen: I am a United States citizen.

eligibility.if_registered_elsewhere: If you're registered elsewhere, Michigan cancels that registration when it processes this one. If you've never registered, this has no effect.
eligibility.digitalSignature: I authorize the Secretary of State to use my stored digital signature for voter registration.
eligibility.signature_on_file: Michigan has your signature on file from your driver's license or state ID and will use it for your registration.

washington.declaration:
I declare that the facts on this voter registration form are true.
  • I am a citizen of the United States, I am a Washington state resident, and I am at least sixteen years old.
  • I am not disqualified from voting due to a court order, and I am not currently serving a sentence of total confinement under the jurisdiction of the department of corrections for a Washington felony conviction, and I am not currently incarcerated for a federal or out-of-state felony conviction.
By checking the box below, you are signing the application electronically. In doing so:
  • You agree you have read and accept the terms of the declaration above.
  • You understand that your electronic signature on this application will constitute the legal equivalent of your signature for this voter registration application.
  • You agree to conduct this voter registration transaction by electronic means and that all laws of the State of Washington will apply to this transaction.
washington.declaration2: If you provided your Washington State Driver License or ID, you understand that the signature will constitute your signature on your voter registration record. If you upload an image of your signature, you understand that the signature you upload will constitute your signature on your voter registration record. You understand that you do not have to register electronically, and may use a paper or other non-electronic from of this voter registration application.
washington.i_confirm: I confirm that I have read and agree to the terms above.
washington.you_must_confirm: You must confirm that you agree to the terms above.
washington.success_text_1: Your voter registration request has been submitted to Washington state election officials.

ballot_lookup_page1.title: Look up your ballot & build your plan to vote
ballot_lookup_page1.subtitle: See every race and measure you'll decide on, research your choices, and send yourself a plan to take to the polls. This is a research guide — not your official ballot.

ballot_lookup_page2.disclaimer: This is your personal research guide, not your official ballot. Explore each race, mark your picks here to remember them, then save to send yourself a copy. You'll cast your real vote at your polling place or by mail.
ballot_lookup_page2.next_notice: Next: send your choices to yourself by email or text to take along.

ballot_lookup_page3.title: Your ballot plan is ready
ballot_lookup_page3.subtitle1: Send yourself a copy to bring along — whether you're voting by mail or in person.
ballot_lookup_page3.no_selections: You have not made any ballot selections. Please go back to edit your choices.
